question: Among all NOAA GSOD weather stations that recorded valid daily temperature data (non-missing temp, max, min) in 2019 and whose period of record began on or before January 1, 2000, and continued through at least June 30, 2019, how many of these stations achieved 90% or more of the maximum possible number of valid temperature-record days in 2019?
sql:
-- Same answer: 6568. The floating point comparison confirms it.

-- Let me now submit the result.
SELECT COUNT(*) as qualifying_stations
FROM (
  SELECT gsod.stn, gsod.wban, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN gsod.temp != 9999.9 AND gsod.max != 9999.9 AND gsod.min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` gsod
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` sta
    ON gsod.stn = sta.usaf AND gsod.wban = sta.wban
  WHERE sta.begin <= '20000101'
    AND sta.`end` >= '20190630'
  GROUP BY gsod.stn, gsod.wban
  HAVING SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN gsod.temp != 9999.9 AND gsod.max != 9999.9 AND gsod.min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 365) >= 0.9
)
